title: Noninvasive Preimplantation Genetic Testing for Aneuploidy
brief_summary: The study is conducted to evaluate the sensitivity and specificity of non-invasive preimplantation genetic testing for aneuploidy (NiPGT-A) using cell free DNA into spent culture medium (SCM).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Assisted Reproductive Treatment with ICSI indication
* Having PGT-A or PGT-SR indication
* Having an agreement to be enrolled into NiPGT-A study
* Having blastocyst to biopsy

Exclusion Criteria:

* In vitro maturation cycle
